chunks: My father (may Allah have mercy on him), and Muhammad ibn al-Hasan, and Ali ibn al-Husayn all narrated to me from Sa'd ibn 'Abdillah, from Muhammad ibn 'Isa ibn 'Ubayd, from Safwan ibn Yahya, from a man, from Sayf al-Tammār, from Abu 'Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

I heard him say: The visitor of al-Husayn (peace be upon him) will be granted intercession on the Day of Judgment for one hundred men, all of whom Hell has become obligatory for, from those who were among the transgressors in this world.

key_terms.الْحُسَيْنِ: Al-Husayn ibn Ali (peace be upon him)
key_terms.الْمُسْرِفِينَ: The transgressors / Those who exceeded limits

ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual benefit of performing Ziyarah to Imam al-Husayn regarding intercession on the Day of Judgment?
ai.summary: In Kamil al-Ziyarat, Ibn Qulawayh records this tradition from Imam al-Sadiq (a.s.), emphasizing the profound spiritual authority of the Ahl al-Bayt in the afterlife. The specific mention of 'al-musrifin' (those who exceeded limits in sin) underscores that Ziyarah serves as a potent means of intercession even for those whose fate in Hell seemed sealed, reflecting the Shia belief in the intercessory power of the Imams as granted by Allah.
